# Canonical colour schema fixtures

This directory contains the canonical JSON Schema definitions and sample data used by the Prismata colour validator tests.

These files restore the expected schema contract for:

- chromascheme-output.schema.yaml
- colour-roles.schema.yaml
- colour-preview-multipane.schema.yaml

They are intentionally lightweight while preserving the validation semantics exercised by the repository test suite.
